candidate.educational_objective: Administer oral alendronate safely by taking it on arising with plain water before food or other medications and remaining upright for at least 30 minutes and until after the first meal to reduce esophageal irritation and preserve absorption.

options.A: I will take it after getting up with 6 to 8 ounces of plain water, before my first food or other medication, and I will remain upright for at least 30 minutes and until after I eat.
options.B: I will take it at bedtime with a small sip of water so the medication remains in contact with my esophagus overnight.
options.C: I will take it with breakfast and milk because food and calcium improve alendronate absorption and protect the esophagus.
options.D: I can lie down immediately after swallowing it as long as I took the tablet with water.

candidate.rationale: A is correct. Current alendronate labeling directs patients to take the tablet upon arising with 6 to 8 ounces of plain water, at least 30 minutes before the first food, beverage, or medication of the day, and not to lie down for at least 30 minutes and until after the first food of the day. These instructions facilitate delivery to the stomach, reduce the potential for esophageal irritation, and avoid reduced absorption from food, beverages, or other medications. B and D increase the risk of prolonged esophageal contact and contradict the upright-position instructions. C is incorrect because food and beverages other than plain water, including calcium-containing products, can reduce absorption. The final item tests the complete label-supported administration sequence rather than asking only for the name of the complication.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The current DailyMed label directly supports the complete administration sequence, the 30-minute upright interval, plain-water requirement, food/medication separation, absorption effect, and rationale of reducing esophageal irritation.
candidate.source_document_title: ALENDRONATE SODIUM tablet — Full Prescribing Information
candidate.source_locator: Section 2.6 Important Administration Instructions: take upon arising with 6-8 ounces plain water at least 30 minutes before first food, beverage or medication; do not lie down for at least 30 minutes and until after first food; instructions facilitate delivery to stomach, reduce esophageal irritation and preserve absorption. Section 4 Contraindications: inability to stand/sit upright for at least 30 minutes and esophageal abnormalities delaying emptying. Section 5.1 Upper Gastrointestinal Adverse Reactions: oral alendronate can cause local upper-GI/esophageal irritation and dosing instructions must be followed.
